cards.title: The engine
cards.text: Everything that makes an agent an agent, whichever host you talk to it through.

cards.title: The loop
cards.text: Sends the history and the tools to the model and runs its tool calls, up to ten rounds a message.

cards.title: Guards
cards.text: Oversized results summarised, cut-off calls never run, a failure sent back with its reason.

cards.title: Usage
cards.text: One ledger line per model request: its tokens, model and time, priced by a dated table.

cards.title: Skills and prompts
cards.text: Prompts embedded by level with the principles first, and the skills an agent writes.

cards.title: Providers
cards.text: One chat client behind a seam. Each model's SDK comes as its own small library.

cards.title: Bootstrap
cards.text: AgentHost reads the settings, loads the skills and the client, and builds the engine.
